primary_decision.statement: Can the operator safely advance the current package?
primary_decision.primary_action: Authenticate when required, then scan the package tracking code

items.label: Conditional access gate and active scan decision
items.purpose: Present exactly one primary action for the current state: sign in when blocked, otherwise scan and read the package decision.
items.consequence_of_omission: The station either exposes retailer data without access control or makes the active package decision ambiguous.

placement.justification: Authentication and scanning are mutually exclusive primary states and each must own first attention and focus.

adaptive_behavior.invariant: Only the primary action for the active access state is visible and focused first.

items.label: Data health and retry
items.purpose: Block scanning until a complete snapshot exists and provide recovery when loading fails.
items.consequence_of_omission: Partial or stale data could be mistaken for a safe empty state.

placement.justification: Snapshot health is a prerequisite but remains subordinate when healthy.

adaptive_behavior.invariant: Blocking health and recovery remain visible before progress tables.

items.demotion_reason: Healthy data reduces to a compact readiness line.

items.label: Progress and exception detail
items.purpose: Show completion counts, no-label work, cancellations, and manual-review records after the active decision.
items.consequence_of_omission: Follow-up context is lost but the current package decision remains safe.

placement.justification: Aggregate and historical information must not interrupt repeated scans.

adaptive_behavior.invariant: Tables stay below the scanner and scroll only within their own regions.

items.demotion_reason: Aggregate context is less consequential than access, readiness, and the current parcel.

items.label: Language and sign-out utility
items.purpose: Allow occasional language changes and deliberate session termination without stealing scan focus.
items.consequence_of_omission: Operators lose secondary controls but package safety is unaffected.

placement.justification: These controls are occasional utilities rather than per-package decisions.

adaptive_behavior.invariant: Utility controls remain reachable after the active task controls and never take automatic focus.

items.demotion_reason: Used occasionally, outside the scan loop.
